2026-09-29 16:57:20.419250 | controller |
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419268 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419291 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419307 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419323 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419339 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419356 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-29 16:57:20.419372 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
